notes: Rounded reported results. Stage B uses a different validation split and its val loss/PPL must not be directly compared with Stage C/D FineWeb rows. Stage C s1, s2, final (step 31,101), Stage D finetune (step 31,104), and GPT-2 use the same Stage C FineWeb-Edu val.bin. Stage D slightly raises FineWeb val loss vs Stage C final (3.181 vs 3.174) while improving LAMBADA (24.5% vs 23.0%); HellaSwag is flat (~30.0%). Both Stage C final and Stage D beat GPT-2 on FineWeb val loss (3.279) but trail on HellaSwag (30.9%) and LAMBADA (32.6%). Playground finetune-val loss (5.234 on 2143 tok) is a separate domain metric and is not shown in this table. Lower FineWeb-Edu validation loss does not establish superior general-purpose capabilities.
